subject: Align MAP milestones with invoicing & payment terms (ClearSky)
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clearsky.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@clearsky.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Align MAP & Billing for ClearSky evaluation

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to run a 4-week evaluation with Redwood; our procurement team asked me to confirm how MAP milestones would map to commercial terms so we can prepare a PO. A few specifics they want clarified:

- Proposed evaluation MAP (attached) includes: 4-week eval, pilot ramp to 50k tokens/day by week 3, and org-level acceptance sign-off at week 4.
- Pricing we discussed: $0.0025/token standard hosted rate, with a 15% ramp discount once we reach sustained commit (50k tokens/day for 7 consecutive days).
- Payment terms: procurement prefers Net60 and requires a PO before any invoices are issued.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly. They also asked whether billing start date is when we flip to production keys or the first paid API call.

Can Redwood accept Net60 with a PO precondition, and can you confirm how billing start and invoice timing would work if we hit commit milestones mid-month? Attached is our MAP and a PO template.

Thanks —
Tom Nguyen
CTO, ClearSky Analytics
Attachment: ClearSky_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@clearsky.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Align MAP & Billing for ClearSky evaluation

Tom —

Appreciate the clear summary and the MAP doc. High level answers below; I’ve pasted the commercial specifics so your procurement and finance teams have something to review.

Quick answers:
- Net terms: Our default hosted terms are Net30. We can make an exception to Net60 if ClearSky provides a signed PO before we transition billing to paid usage AND legal approves the revised payment term clause.
- Billing start: We can support billing start either on (A) the first production API call using paid credentials or (B) the formal acceptance milestone in the MAP (week 4). Our preference for pilots is to start billing on first paid API call and apply credit for the eval period if acceptance isn’t reached, but we can align to your acceptance milestone if you need billing deferred.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly, invoiced in arrears (usage for period X billed after period X closes). If a commit milestone is reached mid-month, the billing reflects actual usage; discounts tied to sustained commit will be applied on the first invoice after commit is validated.

Proposed commercial bullet points to put in the SOW/PO:
- Evaluation: 4-week pilot per attached MAP (weeks 1–4).
- Production ramp target: 50k tokens/day sustained for 7 consecutive days triggers ramp discount.
- Pricing: $0.0025/token standard; 10% discount applied retroactively to the billing period where sustained commit is validated.
- Payment terms: Net30 standard. Exception: Net60 accepted with a signed PO received prior to billing start and Finance sign-off (ClearSky to provide PO by billing start date).
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly, in arrears. Billing start = first paid API request unless both parties agree to defer to MAP acceptance milestone.
- PO requirement: Yes — PO number required for Net60. For Net30 we can proceed without PO but request it for contract records.

Next steps: If this matches your procurement expectations I’ll loop in Legal for minor contract language around payment terms and attach a DocuSign for signature. Ben and Priyom — can you confirm we’re comfortable offering Net60 here with the PO precondition and the 10% retroactive discount?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Align MAP & Billing for ClearSky evaluation

Marissa —

I’m fine with the split: Net30 standard, Net60 with PO-before-billing and Finance sign-off. A couple of internal notes:

- Discount level: you proposed 10% retroactive; Tom originally mentioned 15%. If procurement pushes for 15% we should ask for a 12-month minimum commitment after eval to justify the extra concession.
- Billing start: prefer first paid API call (simpler operationally). If procurement insists on deferral to acceptance milestone, Legal needs a short clause granting Redwood the right to bill for incremental overages discovered after acceptance.
- PO handling: make sure PO template includes the billing address and remit-to info (I’ll attach a standard PO guide).

Approve proceeding to Legal for minor language updates and sending DocuSign. Priyom — can you pre-fill the invoice cadence and discount adjustment rules in the SOW template?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Align MAP & Billing for ClearSky evaluation — Confirmed next steps

Tom —

Thanks — procurement reviewed and the PO will be ready by Monday per your note. We’ve confirmed internally: Redwood will accept Net60 provided the PO is signed and submitted before billing starts and Legal signs the revised clause. We’ll apply a 10% retroactive discount to the invoice covering the period that contains the sustained-commit validation (50k tokens/day for 7 days).

Operational notes (for your finance team):
- Invoices issued monthly in arrears to the bill-to on the PO.
- Billing start = first paid production API call unless both parties confirm in writing to defer to MAP acceptance milestone.
- If sustained commit is validated mid-invoice period, Redwood will reflect the discount on the subsequent invoice after validation and provide a short reconciliation line item.
- Please use the attached PO template to ensure we have remit and billing addresses.

I’ll send a DocuSign with the SOW and the minor payment term change for signature by EOD. Once we have the signed PO and the DocuSign back, we’ll provision production keys and confirm billing start process.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ClearSky_PO_template.pdf (PDF)
